Plugin SDK headers, needed only to compile the plugin.

- `IsiX-headers/` — Horos.framework/Headers from IsiX DICOM Viewer 6.0 (App Store build)
- `Horos-headers/` — Horos.framework/Headers and DCM.framework/Headers from Horos 4.0.1
